1. Find the blackbody chromaticity at the temperature.
2. Move it across the curve by the tint, in CIE 1960 uv.
3. Build the Bradford adaptation from that white to D65, in linear sRGB.
4. Decode each pixel to linear light, multiply by the matrix, encode back and clip.
